constraints: Git subprocess count is a payload-count-independent bounded constant per plan/apply phase

results.summary: Implemented bounded plan/apply target Git snapshots, including real multi-hop checkpoint surfaces, pre-lock drift admission, batch blob/attribute/ignore parsing, recovery ignore-semantic binding, stderr-only phase metrics, scale/process fixtures, and exact-head benchmark/long-validation runners. Focused and exact-head aggregate validation pass. The retained 631-record three-warm-run benchmark reduces plan Git processes from 3153 to 22 and apply Git processes from 13272 to 11.

validation_evidence: Read-only #250 selected-input evidence confirms the retained v0.14 profile has 631 payload records.

Pre-commit independent advisory review findings on plan TOCTOU, O(operations*files), Git identity window, benchmark binding, semantic recovery, rollback admission, and recovery snapshot/lock admission were repaired and regression-tested.

The first exact-head audit rejected 2dc2e2547726ba55dc591dd60dfd958a2b2da2cc for multi-hop per-path Git fallback, missing recovery ignore binding, and ambiguous canonical-content digest labeling; all three findings were repaired and focused-regression tested, with a fresh audit required after the repair commit.

The second exact-head audit rejected 544ba8719a08b28f7f53b4ecff47b94cdd54f80b because the real retained-route target-provenance verifier still resolved Git state outside the active snapshot while GWT-086 mocked that outer verifier. The adapter now injects snapshot HEAD, admin paths, and the batch target surface through nested historical-finalization validation; GWT-086 invokes the real verifier at 3 and 631 paths, and real two-hop GWT-010 forbids every legacy fallback.

The first post-second-audit aggregate receipt at fc691245 failed only direct multi-hop GWT-002 compatibility after package-apply passed. The repair gives standalone verifier calls one bounded admission snapshot while prepare_next_hop and build_plan reuse the same admission snapshot; exact GWT-002 passed in 2.942s, GWT-073 plus GWT-086 passed in 19.591s, and real two-hop GWT-010 passed in 31.980s while asserting exactly 22 actual _snapshot_git calls and forbidding every legacy fallback. An initial instrumentation probe failed in 14.418s because its wrapper omitted the input_bytes keyword; the corrected probe passed without production relaxation.

The pre-terminal audit of 116893c8 found that transaction_lock and route-root resolution still launched two uninstrumented Git processes before the 22 counted snapshot processes. prepare_next_hop now captures and activates admission before the lock, performs a full drift/identity check after lock acquisition, and reuses that snapshot throughout the route and build_plan path. Corrected real two-hop GWT-010 passed with exactly 22 _snapshot_git calls and run_git forbidden; direct GWT-002 plus real GWT-010 passed in 37.069s and the 3/631-path GWT-086 passed in 4.902s.

The terminal exact-head run at 13a33cc4 passed package-apply, multi-hop, and the full 631-record cold plus three-warm benchmark. Warm timing speedups are 44.66x for plan and 186.37x for apply; process reductions are 99.3023% and 99.9171%. No concurrent helper tests or audits ran during this benchmark profile.
Workflow artifact validation passed for 97 workflows and 117 indexed workflow directories.
Sandboxed temp-path PermissionError attempts remain blocked-by-environment evidence; equivalent focused native Windows reruns passed.
One focused selector command contained a non-existent GWT-015 name; GWT-073 and GWT-074 passed in that command, and the corrected exact GWT-015 selector passed separately in 5.143s.
